profile.subtitleJa: ユダヤ地方の地中海沿岸都市
profile.summaryJa: 現在のイスラエル地中海沿岸にあるカイサリア遺跡周辺。ローマ時代の都市域の点は未照合。使徒8:40では、フィリポが到着した町
profile.identityNoteJa: カイサリアと呼ばれた都市は複数ある。使徒8:40のアゾトス後の行程から海辺のカイサリア・マリティマを指すと推定するが、本文は形容語を付けない。
profile.modernLocationJa: 現在のイスラエル地中海沿岸にあるカイサリア遺跡周辺。ローマ時代の都市域の点は未照合。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 使徒8:40でフィリポが到着した町。
profile.locationNoteJa: 候補座標は未採用。地理記述は概略に留め、Pleiades公式固定データまたは考古学機関でこの対象を照合できていないため座標はnull。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB固定版の使徒8:40で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.
WEB固定版の使徒9:30で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
WEB固定版の使徒10:1で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
WEB固定版の使徒10:24で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
WEB固定版の使徒11:11で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

WEB固定版の使徒12:19で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
WEB固定版の使徒18:22で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

WEB固定版の使徒21:8で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
WEB固定版の使徒21:16で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

WEB固定版の使徒23:23で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”
WEB固定版の使徒23:33で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.
WEB固定版の使徒25:1で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.
WEB固定版の使徒25:4で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.
WEB固定版の使徒25:6で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.
WEB固定版の使徒25:13で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.
本文の地名言及は確認。関係は地名の出身地・地域・行程からの関連づけで、出来事の地点とは限らない。原文要旨: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”
